g.text: ssh: guard script + staged orama node upgrade --restart
pre-stop: record raft id, quorum check (reachable-1 >= V/2+1)
a voter wins; node sees leader that is not itself (60 s)
stop units, swap binaries, re-exec new CLI
regenerate configs and units, restart orama-node
nodehealth gate on the index rqlite + gateway (5 min)
restart tenant units (failures are printed, not fatal)
raft state, leader, applied/commit index, HTTP code
Ready: Leader or Follower, leader known, lag at most 200, gateway 200
next node starts (skipped after the last step)
